audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the level chart disagrees with the packet. Content and full read Graves/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Graves; the packet reads Skill/Graves/Graves/Graves/Graves/Graves/Volibear. The whys[] text matches the packet on all seven rows — whys[0] says both level ones are weak, whys[1]-[5] all describe Graves winning, whys[6] says 'Full-tank Voli reclaims it'. The chart even inverts the late game, telling the player he beats a full-tank Volibear at 2+ items.
audit.why: 60.71% is a lane Graves wins early and must close out. The chart was handing him the late game he actually loses and denying him the levels 2-5 window he actually owns.
audit.corrected: All seven win[] entries and phases sides set to the packet chart, ratings 5/7/7/7/7/7/3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike is described purely as Graves' window; Stormbringer's tower disable is never mentioned anywhere on the page. Volibear landing R near your tower disables it, which is the entire reason his level-6 dive works.
audit.why: A Graves who thinks tower range is safe at 6 dies to a dive he could have simply walked away from. Stormbringer is 160/135/110s, so surviving one commit buys a very long window.
audit.corrected: mid now names the tower disable and the 160s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate errors. (a) The stun is attributed to Sky Splitter (E) in early, mid, whys[6] and wants.foe[0]. Riot's Sky Splitter text is damage plus a slow, plus a shield to Volibear if he stands in the blast; the hardCC flag in the kit sits on Thundering Smash (Q), 'Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks'. (b) 'blind his autos' / 'blind him with Smoke Screen' three times — Graves' W reduces sight range and slows on impact, it is not a blind. (c) 'double E charges' and 'first E charge' — Quickdraw has no charges; it is one dash on 16/15/14/13/12s whose cooldown is lowered by landing basic attacks. (d) 'R him into a wall to knock him out' twice — Collateral Damage's text is heavy damage to the first champion plus a cone explosion; no displacement.
audit.why: Every one of these changes what the player does with a cooldown. Waiting out an E that never stunned him means eating the Q that does; expecting a knockback out of R means committing an ultimate as an escape that does not escape.
audit.corrected: The stun is now attributed to Thundering Smash with its 12s rank-1 cooldown, Sky Splitter is described by its slow and self-shield, W as sight denial, E as one refreshing dash, and R as a nuke.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and 0 sequencing cues — the page said 'trade when it's down' without ever saying how long down is.
audit.why: Thundering Smash at 12s rank 1 and Stormbringer at 160s are both long enough to plan a whole trade or a whole dive around.
audit.corrected: Both numbers now appear in early and mid respectively; spikes[1] keys the R to his charge-in.

audit.why: Nothing in the brief indicates a recent change to either kit on 26.15.

edits.after: Collateral Damage answers his all-in: when Thundering Smash charges in — 12s at rank 1 — fire R point-blank and cash the burst.

edits.after: Voli's window: full-tank, Frenzied Maul heals and The Relentless Storm chip let him eat your spread and Sky Splitter slow-chase you down.

edits.before: Voli is a weak, slow level 1 with only his Q charge-up — last-hit at range and don't sit next to him for a free W maul. From level 2-3 this is your lane: weave in with E for the point-blank 4-shell spread, drop Smoke Screen on top of him to blind his autos and Relentless Storm chip so his trade-back whiffs, then back out before his slow lets him stick. The one thing that ruins this window is his Sky-Splitter E — the leap slows then stuns — so trade when it's down and never sit still waiting to eat it.
edits.after: Voli is a weak, slow level 1 with only Thundering Smash — last-hit at range and don't sit next to him for a free Frenzied Maul. From level 2-3 this is your lane: weave in with E for the point-blank 4-shell spread, drop Smoke Screen on top of him so he loses sight of you mid-trade, then back out before his slow lets him stick. What ruins the window is Thundering Smash itself: it stuns the first thing he attacks and is up every 12s at rank 1, so trade on its downtime and never stand still.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 your True Grit armor/MR stacks and double E charges let you win every extended brawl a pre-tank Voli starts. Bait his engage: when he Q-charges or Sky-Splitter E's in, blind him with Smoke Screen so his W maul and empowered autos do nothing, then unload Q plus the spread. At 6, Collateral Damage flips his dive into your kill — R him into a wall when he commits, and hold the second E charge to dash out of his E stun if he lands it first.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 your True Grit stacks and a Quickdraw your autos keep refreshing win every extended brawl a pre-tank Voli starts. Bait his engage: when Thundering Smash charges, Smoke Screen him so he loses you, then unload Q plus the spread. At 6 respect Stormbringer — it disables your tower where he lands, so the dive is real — but it is 160s at rank 1, and Collateral Damage turns that commit into your kill.

edits.before: This is where Voli takes it back. Once he's full tank with W maul heals and Relentless Storm chipping through, your shell spread stops mattering and his Sky-Splitter E locks you down long enough to walk you out. Don't duel him at 2+ items — your job was to snowball the 3-6 window into a lead, then play as a mobile skirmisher and roam off this lane. If the game went long and even, respect his all-in, kite with E and Smoke Screen, and let your team peel; you won't out-brawl a fed tank Voli alone.
edits.after: This is where Voli takes it back. Once he's full tank with Frenzied Maul heals and The Relentless Storm chipping through, your shell spread stops mattering and Sky Splitter's slow sticks you long enough to walk you down. Don't duel him at 2+ items — your job was to snowball the 3-6 window into a lead, then skirmish and roam off this lane. If the game went long and even, respect his all-in, kite with E and Smoke Screen, and let your team peel; you won't out-brawl a fed tank Voli alone.

notes: The stun was attributed to Sky Splitter across four fields. I moved it to Thundering Smash, which Riot's text explicitly stuns, and described Sky Splitter by the slow and self-shield its text does state — I did NOT write that Sky Splitter cannot stun, because absence from Riot's description is not evidence of absence and the kit file's needsResearch is empty by design.
